findings.description: The features do not explicitly define a no-auditor lock path after operator dispositions are recorded. F001 says every pre-impl lock run appends a new sufficiency round, while F002 evaluates the just-completed round, which implies another auditor invocation instead of reusing the latest ledger entry as required by the completion test.
findings.recommendation: Add a pre-auditor lock branch that evaluates the latest committed round plus recorded dispositions and permits the lock when all current blocking findings are disposed, without appending a new round or invoking the auditor.

findings.description: F001 and F003 define incompatible identity semantics for changed findings. F001 requires content-derived finding ids where materially changed content gets a new id, but F003 says a disposition is invalidated when the same finding id recurs with a materially changed content fingerprint, which cannot happen under a strictly content-derived id.
findings.recommendation: Separate a stable logical finding key from a content/version fingerprint, then invalidate dispositions when the logical key recurs with a different material content fingerprint.

findings.description: The plan_contract waiver rule is weakened by the generic disposition handling. F002 says new conceptual plan_contract findings block unless explicitly waived, but F003 says deferred_to_impl and split_to_followup_plan suppress blocks generally, which would allow non-waiver dispositions to bypass plan_contract findings.
findings.recommendation: Constrain plan_contract suppression to waived_with_reason unless the contract is intentionally expanded to allow a named alternate disposition for that class.

findings.description: The C0 replay fixture depends on historical findings being classed as matrix_pin or implementation_detail, but F001 conservatively falls back missing classes to plan_contract. If the committed C0 evidence predates the new class field, F004 cannot both replay real evidence and recognize round-6 medium pin findings as disposition-eligible.
findings.recommendation: Specify an offline fixture classification artifact or migration rule for historical C0 findings, and make tests prove the fallback is not accidentally applied to the fixture labels.

findings.description: The convergence policy is not exhaustive over the closed finding class enum. It covers high severity, plan_contract, and the eligible matrix_pin or implementation_detail classes, but does not state the verdict for medium or low editorial and scope_guard findings.
findings.recommendation: Define the default verdict for every non-eligible class, preferably an explicit hard_block branch with the class and severity named in the refusal output.

findings.description: accepted_into_plan is underspecified for lock authorization. F003 says it expects the plan artifact to change, but does not require or test a plan/input fingerprint change before treating the disposition as non-blocking, so a lock could pass without evidence that the finding was actually accepted into the plan.
findings.recommendation: Require accepted_into_plan dispositions to reference a changed plan/input fingerprint or clarify that accepted_into_plan is only a pending state until the artifact changes.
